name: 247. Bedrock automatic cache control (top-level cache_control)
description: Issue #8541. Anthropic automatic caching puts a single cache_control on the request instead of on a block. Bedrock Converse has no request-level marker, and Bifrost used to park the field in ExtraParams and never read it, so every request billed as uncached input (cache_creation_input_tokens=0, cache_read_input_tokens=0) with no error. The fix translates it into a cachePoint after the last cacheable block. Each route sends the same ~4.5k-token system prefix twice with only a top-level cache_control: turn 1 must report cache tokens (a write, or a read when a recent run warmed the cache), turn 2 must read. Routes: the Anthropic SDK surface, the neutral chat-completions surface (unknown top-level fields ride ExtraParams), and the native invoke surface (the field rides the invoke body's unknown fields). Red before the fix: both turns report zero cache tokens on every route.
